summary: This change would allow Catalyst to push down unrelated filters, dynamic partition pruning, and other optimizations for expensive nondeterministic UDFs while preserving existing deterministic=false guarantees. The discussion centers on a proposal to add SQL‑standard GROUPS window frames to Spark SQL, detailing semantics, implementation feasibility, and testing. Serge Rielau proposes a new SQL data type, OBJECT, that matches structured fields by name rather than position, addressing the current limitations of STRUCT. The thread reports updates to the SPIP proposal, adding detailed security guarantees, a dedicated PolicyEnforcement operator, and handling of restricted writes and leaks.
